Division.' — contains 'to start the season', does NOT contain 'over their last 10'; season strip cells = START | GF | GA | DIFF (values 0-2 | 1 | 14 | -13) with NO 'LAST 10' cell (PG has 2 GP). (h) Desk safe zone: PLAY, TALK, STOP all present, visible, tappable; title 'PRINCE GEORGE COUGARS · ON THE DESK' sits above the button row (screenshot verified). Live Desk voice flow was NOT exercised per instruction. (i) NHL parity /team/VGK renders identity + Reggie+Marc desk + 'AROUND THE PACIFIC' rail with 8 division cards (VGK,EDM,ANA,LAK,SJS,SEA,CGY,VAN) + season strip that correctly switches to 'RECORD' (not START) and shows the 'LAST 10' cell (7-0-3) because VGK has 82 GP (>=10). Zero page errors, zero console errors across all 7 UI checks. Two benign deprecation warnings only (see react_native_issues). Deprecated packages detected: none.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — web-only React Native shim complaint from some upstream style. Non-blocking; suggest sweeping styles to boxShadow at leisure.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — appears from LinearGradient overlay in TeamDesk.tsx:231 (pointerEvents="none"). Non-blocking; move to style={{pointerEvents:'none'}} when convenient.

critical_code_review_comments: team/[id].tsx: crumb-league and crumb-division are keyboard-focusable Pressables with distinct testIDs — good. division rail correctly disables the self-card via `disabled={here}` and skips both prefetch and router.push in onPress, and the visual `styles.divCardHere` treatment provides a clear 'you are here' cue. Verified aria-disabled=true on web.

team/[id].tsx: early-season logic `early = gp>0 && gp<10` gates BOTH the read-line copy AND the LAST 10 strip cell (`hasL10 = !early && !!form.l10 && form.l10 !== '–'`). Correct behavior confirmed on PG (2 GP -> no LAST 10) and VGK (82 GP -> LAST 10 shown).

league/[code].tsx: `division` query param floats matching division to the top via a stable sort (`a.name === division ? -1 : b.name === division ? 1 : 0`) — other divisions keep their natural order. Confirmed order on tap: [B.C. Division, East Division, Central Division, U.S. Division].

lib/cache.ts: 60s TTL map + `prefetchTeam` fired on `onPressIn` for both league-team-* rows and division-team-* cards makes sideways moves feel instant. Simple, correct, no memory leak (single Map keyed by `league:abbr`).

TeamDesk.tsx: PLAY/TALK/STOP controls sit inside a `.bottom` container with a protected `lowerThird` gradient behind them, and the title uses `numberOfLines={2}`. Buttons remain fully visible and tappable regardless of title length — verified visually on PG and VGK.
Live Desk voice flow (converse / TTS / recorder) was NOT invoked in this test pass per the freeze directive. Only visibility + disabled-state checks on PLAY/TALK/STOP were performed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 UI flows: crumb-league, crumb-division float, league-team row, division-team rail, next-team, player nav, NHL VGK parity)

seed_data_creation: None — live WHL PG (2 GP early season) and live NHL VGK (82 GP) endpoints drove all tests.
